objective: Preallocate ORDER BY pushdown schema lookup keys from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate ORDER schema keys
tasks.result: ORDER BY primary-key LIMIT pushdown schema lookup now uses an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for schema:<table> keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for schema:<table> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in primary_key_order_scan_limit() schema lookup key construction.
Generated schema key bytes, ORDER BY primary-key LIMIT pushdown, range pushdown, index-cache behavior, and general SELECT ORDER BY behavior are unchanged.
The first focused helper test rebuilt dependencies and took longer than later test runs.
git diff --check printed the existing CRLF normalization warning for src/execution/query/order.rs while exiting successfully.
